main_text.p: Congruus] Consentaneus : Accommodatum aliquid naturæ, ad naturam. Proprium est epistolæ, Cic. Justa ætas, Vlp. Legitima ætas legibus præscripta, Liv. Competens, Vlp.

Conjicere] Conjecturam de aliquâ re facere. Conjecturâ duci ad suspicandum. Suspicione assequi. Conjecturâ, animo & cogitatione prospicere. Argumentari & conjecturâ persequi, Cic. Subolet patri. Subsensit, Ter. Colligere ex animo suo, Ovid. De meis venatur verbis. Scire quod nescias, Plaut.
Conjugium] Connubium, Cic. Jugum, Plaut. Conditio, Caj Matrimonium, Cic.

Conjurare] Conjurare in ruinam alicujus, Claud. Conjurationem facere contra aliquem, Cic. Fœderari. Piaculô quôdam fœderantur de Christianis, Oclav. Ap. Minut. Jurare in facinus aliquod, Ovid. Dare & accipere fidem, ex Gr.
Conjuratus] Conjuratorum manus permagna. Juratus, Cic. Conspirati, Suet.
Connivere] Dissimulare. Indulgere, Cic. Apertis oculis transilire, Sen. Vid. Indulgere.
Connubia à Deo] Connubia sunt fatalia.
Conquirere] Perquirere vasa, Cic. Pervestigare omnia. Ubi quicquid est, Cic.
Conquisitus] Lecti juvenes, Virg. Delecti viri. Exercitus superbissimo delectu & durissima conquisitione collectus. Vir à viro lectus, Cic.

page.notes: Catchword-like word "tingit" at lower right is the start of the next line's continuation, read as "tingit". Some entries at the line ends are faint; the last line reads "Attingit" with the final word partly cut off by the page edge.
